name: GGG ~ Gorgeous Gyaru Girlfriends
source:
Depressed? Lack of motivation? Just horny in general? Then maybe a good sex with the carefree Gyarus will do you some favors!

Gorgeous Gyaru Girlfriends (or GGG) is a visual novel that puts you in the shoes of the typically bland, timid MC on his way to discover a life extraordinarily different from his own, and make a good harem out of it. Capture their hearts and unlock all your deep, dark desires... Are the Gyarus just rebelling girls? Can you even tell who's naughty and who's not? 

[From [url=https://annodesha44.itch.io/ggg]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
郁闷？缺乏动力？一般只是性欲旺盛吗？那么也许与无忧无虑的Gyarus进行一次美好的性爱会给你带来一些好处！

《华丽辣妹女友》（Gorgeous Gyaru Girlfriends，简称GGG）是一部视觉小说，让你扮演典型的温和、胆怯的MC，探索与自己截然不同的生活，并从中打造一个美好的后宫。俘获他们的心，解开你所有深沉、黑暗的欲望……加鲁斯只是叛逆的女孩吗？你能分得清谁顽皮谁不顽皮吗？
